# Fitness Education Online

> > Leading provider of NASM, AFAA, ACE, and CANFITPRO-approved continuing education courses for certified personal trainers and fitness professionals in the USA, Canada, UK, Australia, and New Zealand.

Fitness Education Online (FEO) offers evidence-based CEU/CEC courses for fitness certification maintenance and specialized training in areas like mobility, pre/post-natal fitness, senior training, and online coaching. Founded by industry expert Jono Petrohilos, FEO provides self-paced online courses recognized by major certification bodies including NASM, AFAA, ACE, CANFITPRO, and NFPT.

## Key Topics

- NASM CEUs (Continuing Education Units)
- AFAA CECs (Continuing Education Credits)
- ACE approved courses
- CANFITPRO CEC certification
- Personal trainer certification renewal
- Self-paced online learning
- Jono Petrohilos (founder/instructor)
- Certified Personal Trainer (CPT) education
- Fitness professional development
- Mobility training certification
- Pre/post-natal fitness specialist
- Senior fitness certification
- Bootcamp instructor training
- Online fitness business development
- Evidence-based fitness education

## CEU/CEC Certification Programs

- [Personal Trainer CEU Courses Online](https://fitnesseducationonline.com/ceu-training-courses): NASM, AFAA, ACE & Canfitpro approved CEU courses for fitness professionals
- [NASM CEU Courses](https://fitnesseducationonline.com/nasm-approved-ceu): NASM-approved CEU courses for personal trainer certification renewal
- [Approved canfitpro CEC Courses](https://fitnesseducationonline.com/canfitpro): CANFITPRO-approved CEC courses for personal trainers & group instructors
- [NASM CEU Course Bundles and Canfitpro Bundles](https://fitnesseducationonline.com/course-bundles): NASM CEU & canfitpro CEC course bundles for certification maintenance
- [Personal Trainer Certification](https://fitnesseducationonline.com/personal-trainer-certification): UK-recognized online personal trainer certificate with Ofqual regulation

## Specialized Training Certifications

- [Mobility Training Certification Courses](https://fitnesseducationonline.com/mobility-certification): Mobility coach certification courses with NASM & AFAA CEUs
- [Pre- and Post-Natal Certification](https://fitnesseducationonline.com/pre-post-natal-personal-training-certification): Pre & post-natal training certification for pregnancy fitness specialists
- [Training Women Certification](https://fitnesseducationonline.com/training-women-certification): Women's fitness specialist certification including menopause training
- [Senior Fitness Certification](https://fitnesseducationonline.com/seniors-fitness-certification): Senior fitness specialist certification for training older adults
- [PILATES Instructor Certification](https://fitnesseducationonline.com/pilates): NASM & AFAA-recognized mat Pilates instructor certification online
- [Kettlebell Certification](https://fitnesseducationonline.com/kettlebell-certification-nasm): NASM/AFAA/ACE-approved kettlebell certification for personal trainers

## Programming & Business Development

- [Programming Certification Courses Online](https://fitnesseducationonline.com/programming): Fitness programming certification with GLP-1 & wearable tech courses
- [Fitness Programming Level 1: Start Designing Workouts](https://fitnesseducationonline.com/product/programming-level-1): Programming Essentials Level 1 by Jono Petrohilos with NASM CEUs
- [Online Essentials: How to Start Training Clients Online](https://fitnesseducationonline.com/product/online-essentials-how-to-start-training-clients-online): Launch online personal training business with NASM/AFAA CEU course
- [Bootcamp Level 1](https://fitnesseducationonline.com/product/bootcamp-level-1): Bootcamp Level 1 certification with NASM/AFAA/ACE CEUs by Jono Petrohilos
- [Functional Training Courses](https://fitnesseducationonline.com/functional-training-courses): Battlerope & suspension training functional fitness CEU courses
